evals.name: tracking-issue-confirmed-before-reuse
evals.prompt: 当前分支只改 skills 的 GitHub 模板。请准备 PR，先查找已有长期维护 Issue，能复用就不要新建，也不要关闭它。
evals.expected_output: Shows matching issue candidates and confirms the selected number before linking; prepares the repository-template draft without remote writes.
expectations: Discovery is not automatic issue association approval
Uses refs or related to for a confirmed long-lived issue, not closes/fixes/resolves
Does not create a duplicate issue after a suitable issue is confirmed
Uses current repository PR fields and reports actual template validation evidence

evals.name: replacement-current-template-historical-checks
evals.prompt: 准备一个替代旧 PR 的草稿。旧正文只有 Summary/Changes/Motivation，旧测试没有在当前 HEAD 重跑。保留原 Issue、风险、回滚和 Replaces #42。
evals.expected_output: Migrates old facts into the current template, preserves the replacement relationship, and identifies historical checks rather than reporting them as current passes.
expectations: Reads the current PR template rather than copying the old structure
Preserves issue links, risk, rollback, and Replaces #42
Does not claim historical CI or commits verify current HEAD
Does not close the old PR or edit metadata without separate approval

evals.name: skill-template-verification-matrix
evals.prompt: 这次同时改了 SKILL.md 的触发边界、references 中远程写确认步骤和 .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE 的 dropdown。帮我准备 PR，列出完整影响范围与验证。
evals.expected_output: Maps trigger behavior, action authorization, and form options to targeted scenario, reference, and syntax checks without treating proposed checks as completed.
expectations: Fills affected areas and concrete impact notes
Selects checks from actual repository scripts, evals, and form fields
Distinguishes actual results, historical evidence, and checks not run
Includes concrete risks and an executable rollback path

evals.name: draft-only-with-unpublished-issue-and-head
evals.prompt: 只准备 PR 草稿。当前 branch 没 push，也没有 Issue；不要创建或编辑任何 GitHub 资源。
evals.expected_output: Returns issue and PR drafts with unresolved identifiers, without pushing or creating resources to complete the draft.
expectations: No git push, gh issue create/edit, gh pr create/edit, or metadata writes
Does not use gh pr create --dry-run as a no-write substitute
Reports No GitHub writes performed
Lists subsequent issue, push, and PR actions as requiring separate approval

evals.name: ambiguous-create-failure-read-before-retry
evals.prompt: 刚才 gh pr create 返回网络错误，没看到 URL。直接再创建一次吧。正文用那个包含代码和反引号的多行文件。
evals.expected_output: Inspects remote state before any retry, uses a confirmed body file, and reads back any created PR before proposing corrective writes.
expectations: Avoids blind duplicate creation after an ambiguous failure
Uses --body-file for CLI or -F body=@file for raw API, not literal -f body=@file
Compares remote title/body/base/head and issue relation to the approved draft
Confirms a specific corrective edit if readback differs
